scope: Source-only four-engine v2 orchestration/admission/statistics review plus hashing and saved JSON metadata inspection. No numerical kernels, compilation, or benchmark timing executed by this reviewer.

preserved_v1.state: preserved unrun; v2 is a separate protocol

reviewed: Eight fixed massive Euclidean N2/N3 rank0/1 batch1/32 families retained, with unchanged qualified Rust and original IREGI/COLLIER binaries.
External baselineTIRust/candidateTIRust labels map to existing baseline/candidate binary selectors; all five permitted ratios have TIRust in the numerator.
Forty-eight quartets comprise all 24 engine permutations twice with Random(173); each requested pair has 24 numerator-first and 24 denominator-first blocks.

One shared positive integer iteration count; initial n=1, ten warm calls, at most eight calibration rounds, fastest interval >=100ms, exact 1.10 margin transition, fixed counts after calibration, fixed 700s runtime cap.

All complete tensor/Laurent arrays, successful statuses, six-output master captures and unchanged direct controls validated before/after outside timing; own snapshots compared to prior optimized qualification.

COLLIER CHECK validates finite complete native arrays and three independent pole probes with <=1e-12 errors plus independent UV identities; BENCH requires null pole metadata and exact own native arrays/status/mode/clock snapshot.

Rust measured intervals retain whole-call result allocation/drop, status checks, black_box arguments/results; capture and profiling disabled. Both Fortran elapsed values are explicitly reconstructed from floating ns/call times iterations.
Prior qualification bindings, helper/source provenance, raw log digest, subprocess exits and before/after input hashes checked; failed, short-block, budget-inconclusive and unrun rows remain visible.

Analyzer checks global controls/provenance/exit admission, mandatory bound before/after raw captures, exact own qualified snapshots, calibration progression, all 48 acceptance quartets, and complete one-to-one accounting of raw serials including both controls.

Paired ratio medians use existing 10000-resample 99% bootstrap and <=2% relative interval-width gate; order strata and slower-pair counts retained. Invalid admission propagates to nested ratio gates; malformed/partial run data produces eight visible unqualified families under available frozen input fixtures.

statistics_controls.executor: parent; source and final receipt hashes independently checked

limitations: This receipt is not a quiet-window authorization or performance result. No four-engine measurement has been assessed here.

COLLIER IR-zero construction and UV identities apply to this fixed massive IR-finite N2/N3 rank0/1 corpus; they do not extend coverage to rejected N4 diagnostics, thresholds, complex masses or arbitrary ranks.
The optimized pair qualification was executed by the owner; this review inspected source and saved qualification inventory/bindings, not an independent rerun of numerical kernels.
Fortran drivers expose floating ns/call and clock frequency rather than raw integer ticks. Numeric COLLIER flags are represented only through the pinned driver sticky stability decision.
Synthetic controls cover the listed cases, not an exhaustive malformed-input proof. Higher precision and Dual qualification remains the separately bound earlier evidence.
Production adoption and an adopted-source whole benchmark require separate decisions; this remains a private candidate experiment.
